subject.description: Engaging, concise subject line with no clickbait or false promises

body.description: Email body content strictly adhering to verified facts (80 to 200 words)

personalization_summary.description: Explanation of why this message is relevant to the recipient

claims_used.description: List of explicit factual claims made in the body, each mapped to its input fact_id

fact_id.description: ID of the input fact from which this claim was derived

claim.description: The exact factual assertion made in the draft

missing_information_warnings.description: Explicit notices if critical info (e.g. salary, specific tech stack) was missing from the verified facts rather than hallucinated

confidence_note.description: Model self-assessment of draft appropriateness and alignment with verified inputs
